title: Spam Classifier Evaluation Report
description: Independent structural, invariant, and classification-quality evaluation outcomes. All classification metrics (SPAM/HAM precision, recall, F1, macro-F1, REVIEW count, and REVIEW rate) MUST use only cases whose case_group is synthetic_held_out. Synthetic-controlled and validation-only cases MUST NOT contribute. total_valid_evaluation_case_count counts only valid synthetic_held_out cases.

evaluation_dataset_valid.description: True only when the frozen dataset contains at least 15 valid synthetic_held_out cases, including at least five SPAM and five HAM cases; required normal, boundary, ambiguous, and adversarial scenario coverage across synthetic_held_out and synthetic_controlled groups; unique case_id values; and a non-empty requirement_refs array for every case, with every entry referencing an existing FR or SC ID. Valid field combinations are mandatory: synthetic_held_out and synthetic_controlled cases MUST use one of normal, boundary, ambiguous, or adversarial; contain a non-empty English message; have exactly one SPAM or HAM expected_label; and have null expected_error. validation_only cases MUST use missing or malformed; have null expected_label; and have a non-empty expected_error. A missing case MUST have no message value, while a malformed case MUST contain a value that violates the valid-message input contract. No other combination of case_group, scenario, message, expected_label, and expected_error is valid. All case_group and scenario values must be from their allowed sets. The manifest MUST contain at least one separate missing validation_only case and at least one separate malformed validation_only case. Missing and malformed validation_only cases must be separate from classification-quality cases. Synthetic held-out messages must be isolated from training and every model or preprocessing fitting step. Synthetic-controlled and validation_only cases do not count toward the 15-case minimum or classification metrics.

overall_pass.description: True only when structural validation, invariant validation, dataset validity, and classification-quality evaluation all pass.

failure_evidence.description: Non-sensitive structured failures from independently executed evaluation stages.

review_rate.description: REVIEW count among synthetic_held_out cases divided by total_valid_evaluation_case_count when the denominator is greater than zero; 0 when the denominator is zero. Synthetic_controlled and validation_only cases are excluded.

total_valid_evaluation_case_count.description: Number of valid cases with case_group synthetic_held_out included in classification metrics. Synthetic_controlled and validation_only cases are excluded. At least 15 synthetic_held_out cases are required for evaluation_dataset_valid to be true; this count may be zero in an invalid report.
